note: Planet tab text for build-planets.mjs. name / description are the game's own English strings (Korean from game_names_ko.json); values fill the game's #V_ONE / #V_TWO placeholders (from the wiki). page = wiki page. stratagem = how it changes stratagems in the stratagem details (factor on the shown value; types = wiki stratagem_type, none = every stratagem). Status effects have no single game description, so detail lines summarize the wiki Status Effects page; test-planets.mjs checks every number in them against that page. name null = no game name: ko is the site's own translation (user decision 2026-11-19), as are biomeNames and archetypeNames (the game names neither).

conditions.name: ACID STORMS
conditions.description: Corrosive acid storms temporarily reduce armor effectiveness for both enemy and friendly units.

conditions.name: BLIZZARDS
conditions.description: Intense blizzards reduce mobility and moderately reduce visibility for both enemy and friendly units.

conditions.name: Extreme Cold
conditions.description: Periods of freezing temperatures reduce rate of fire and delay heat buildup in weapons.

conditions.name: FIRE TORNADOS
conditions.description: Planet is ravaged by deadly fire tornados.

conditions.name: INTENSE HEAT
conditions.description: Periods of high temperatures increase stamina drain and speed up heat buildup in weapons.

conditions.name: METEOR STORMS
conditions.description: Meteors impact the surface causing massive damage.

conditions.name: SANDSTORMS
conditions.description: Dense sandstorms reduce mobility and greatly reduce visibility for both enemy and friendly units.

conditions.name: THICK FOG
conditions.description: Dense fog lightly reduces visibility for both enemy and friendly units.

conditions.name: TREMORS
conditions.description: Frequent earthquakes stun players and enemies alike.

conditions.name: VOLCANIC ACTIVITY
conditions.description: Volcanos throw burning rocks around this planet.

gloom.name: LIGHT GLOOM COVER
gloom.description: Gloom particles interfere with landing Pelicans, increasing extraction times by 20 seconds.

gloom.name: MODERATE GLOOM BLANKET
gloom.description: The Gloom covers this planet completely, obstructing a variety of logistical operations.\nExtraction times are increased by 30 seconds and Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 20%.

gloom.name: HEAVY GLOOM SHROUD
gloom.description: This planet is completely engulfed by the Gloom, severely impeding logistical support.\nExtraction times are increased by 40 seconds, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30% and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%.

gloom.name: GLOOM SOURCE
gloom.description: This planet continually produces a thick atmospheric Gloom cover, rendering logistical support extremely challenging.\nTotal Reinforcements are reduced by 20%, Eagle Re-arm time is increased by 30% and Ammo from pickups is reduced by 50%.

modifiers.name: CIVILIANS & SEAF IN AREA
modifiers.description: SEAF units and loyal civilians are both on the battlefield.

modifiers.name: ROVING SHRIEKERS
modifiers.description: Flying Shrieker swarms traverse the battlefield.

modifiers.name: LEVIATHAN BLOCKADE
modifiers.description: Flying Leviathan warships patrol the battlefield.

events.name: ORBITAL FLUCTUATIONS
events.description: All Orbital Stratagems have an increased cooldown.

events.name: MEDICAL SUPPLY STRAIN
events.description: Number of stims each Helldiver deploys with decreased by #V_ONE.

special.name: CLASS 1 EXOSTORM
special.description: Isolated Exostorm pockets are materializing across the planet and rapidly gaining momentum.

ko: 일루미닛 엑소스파이어가 일으키는 폭풍입니다. 행성의 날씨 관련 환경 조건이 계속 켜져 있고, 짧은 경고 뒤 번개가 가끔 떨어집니다.
en: A storm raised by Illuminate Exospires. The planet's weather conditions stay on for good, and lightning strikes now and then after a short warning.

special.name: CLASS 2 EXOSTORM
special.description: Exostorm fronts are coalescing into a dense system that threatens to engulf the entire planet.

ko: 보통 엑소스톰이 시작되고 72시간 뒤 2단계가 됩니다. 번개가 잦아지고, 토네이도가 돌아다니며 물건과 생명체를 들어 올립니다.
en: It usually reaches class 2 72 hours after the exostorm begins. Lightning comes more often, and tornados roam, lifting items and living things.

special.name: CLASS 3 EXOSTORM
special.description: The Exostorm has reached critical mass, enveloping the planet in an ominous tempest that defies atmospheric physics.

ko: 보통 시작 120시간 뒤 3단계가 됩니다. 번개가 매우 잦고 토네이도가 더 많아지며, 강한 바람이 계속 붑니다.
en: It usually reaches class 3 120 hours after it begins. Lightning is constant, tornados are more common and a strong wind never stops.

special.name: Heavy SEAF Presence
special.description: Conventional SEAF forces are heavily deployed across this planet, and may directly support Helldiver missions.

ko: 펠리컨이 SEAF 분대를 최대 3개까지 전장에 내려 줍니다. 헬다이버가 SEAF 병사를 죽이면 1명당 요청 신청서 25가 깎이고, 9번 무분별하게 죽이면 반역자로 찍혀 구축함 포격을 받습니다.
en: Pelicans drop up to 3 SEAF squads into the mission. Each SEAF soldier a Helldiver kills costs 25 Requisition Slips, and 9 reckless kills brand you a traitor under Super Destroyer fire.

ko: 산성에 묻으면 4초 동안 느려지고 지속 피해를 받을 수 있습니다.
테르미니드의 산성 공격(스피터·스퓨어·차저·바일 타이탄 등)과 벌레 지뢰, 스포어 버스트 변종이 겁니다.
en: Acid slows you for 4 seconds and may deal damage over time.
Terminid acid attacks (Spitters, Spewers, Chargers, Bile Titans and others), Bug Mines and the Spore Burst Strain apply it.

ko: 가슴 부상, 가시 식물, 철조망에 닿으면 걸리며 지속 피해를 받습니다. 셋은 따로 겹칩니다.
en: A chest injury, spike plants and barbed wire each cause it, as separate effects, dealing damage over time.

ko: 불은 AP 4 장갑까지 뚫고 기본 3초 동안 탑니다. 큰 적은 불 피해 배율이 높을 수 있습니다(임페일러 1.7배).
화염방사기처럼 직접 뿜는 불은 적을 혼란에 빠뜨리고 느리게 합니다(대형 이상 비벌레 적 제외).
네이팜 이글·네이팜 포격·일회성 네이팜은 1초 동안 훨씬 강한 화상을 더합니다.
en: Fire gets through AP 4 armor and burns for 3 seconds by default. Bigger enemies can take more fire damage (Impalers 1.7x).
A direct flame stream, as from flamethrowers, panics and slows enemies (not large or bigger non-Terminids).
Napalm Eagle, Napalm Barrage and Expendable Napalm add a much stronger burn that lasts 1 second.

ko: 본체 체력에만 지속 피해를 주고 혼란에 빠뜨립니다. 혼란에 빠진 적은 아무 방향으로나 움직이고 공격하며, 가스에 걸리면 25% 느려집니다.
가스 수류탄·가스 타격·가스 박격포 등은 6초(혼란 5초), 스테릴라이저와 독 브레스는 10초(혼란 9초)입니다.
en: Damage over time to main health only, plus confusion: confused enemies move and attack in random directions, and gassed units are 25% slower.
Gas grenades, Gas Strikes, the Gas Mortar and similar last 6 seconds (5 s confusion); the Sterilizer and Dog Breath last 10 seconds (9 s confusion).

ko: 적은 잠시 움직이거나 공격하지 못하고, 헬다이버는 크게 느려집니다.
아크 무기·테슬라 탑·칼트롭 등 1.5초, EMS 박격포·퍼멜러·퍼시파이어 3초, 기절 수류탄·기절 무기류 5초, 기절 포드 부스터 10초.
궤도 EMS 타격·EMS 박격포·SEAF 정전기장탄은 대부분의 적을 묶는 구름을 만들고, 그 안의 헬다이버는 느려지며 스태미나를 잃습니다.
en: Enemies cannot move or attack for a moment; Helldivers are heavily slowed.
Arc weapons, the Tesla Tower, Caltrops and others 1.5 s; the EMS Mortar, Pummeler and Pacifier 3 s; stun grenades and stun melee 5 s; the Stun Pods booster 10 s.
Orbital EMS Strike, the EMS Mortar and SEAF static field shells leave a cloud that holds most enemies; Helldivers inside are slowed and lose stamina.

ko: 녹셔스 변종만 겁니다. 6초 동안 초당 2(내구 5) 산성 피해를 주고, 강한 독은 화면도 흐리게 만듭니다.
독 취약이 쌓일수록 독 피해가 1.4·1.8·2.8·4.2배가 되며 최대 4중첩입니다. 각성제는 중첩을 2 줄이지만 독 피해는 막지 못합니다.
3중첩부터는 독이 걸린 동안 질주할 수 없으니 2중첩을 넘기지 마세요.
en: Only the Noxious Strain applies it: 2 per second (5 durable) acid damage for 6 seconds; Heavy Poison also blurs your screen.
Each stack of Poison Vulnerability raises poison damage to 1.4, 1.8, 2.8 and 4.2 times, up to 4 stacks. A stim removes 2 stacks but does not stop the poison.
From 3 stacks you cannot sprint while poisoned, so do not let it pass 2.

ko: 적 공격의 경직 수치가 10 이상이면 비틀거려 각성제 사용 같은 동작이 끊기고, 25 이상이면 날아가 넘어집니다. 넘어진 동안은 폭발 피해가 90% 줄어듭니다.
굳건한 바위 패시브는 경직을 30% 줄여 36 미만 공격에는 넘어지지 않습니다.
en: Enemy attacks with stagger 10 or more stagger you and interrupt actions such as stimming; 25 or more ragdoll you, with 90% less explosion damage while down.
The Rock Solid passive cuts stagger by 30%, so attacks under 36 no longer ragdoll you.
